steps.title: Turn off airplane mode
steps.detail: Open the Action Center or the network settings and switch airplane mode off. The screenshot shows it is on, which blocks all wireless connections.

steps.title: Reconnect to your Wi-Fi network
steps.detail: Choose your home or office network from the list and enter the Wi-Fi password if asked. Once connected, open a website to confirm the internet works.

steps.title: Turn Wi-Fi on
steps.detail: In the same Network & internet settings, switch Wi-Fi to on. Wait a few seconds for the laptop to scan for networks.

steps.title: Restart the laptop
steps.detail: Restart the whole computer, then check whether the Wi-Fi networks appear in the list after it starts up again.

steps.title: Load paper into tray 2
steps.detail: The printer reports that tray 2 is empty. Add paper to tray 2 and make sure it sits flat under the guides.

steps.title: Check the printer display for errors
steps.detail: Look at the printer's control panel for any other message, such as a jam or open door. Close any open covers and clear anything that is blocking the paper path.

steps.title: Set the printer back to online
steps.detail: Open Printers & scanners, select HP LaserJet 4th Floor, and choose Open queue. If the printer shows Use Printer Online, select it.

steps.title: Print a test page
steps.detail: Open Printers & scanners, select HP LaserJet 4th Floor, and choose Print a test page. If the page prints, send your document again.

steps.title: Restart the printer
steps.detail: Turn the printer off, wait about 30 seconds, and turn it back on. Wait until it shows ready before sending a new print job.
